ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, in parallelogram $ABCD$, $AC$ and $BD$ intersect at point $O$. $E$ is the midpoint of $OD$. When $AE$ is extended to intersect $DC$ at point $F$, what is the ratio of the area of $\triangle DEF$ to the area of $\triangle OAB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let $O$ be the intersection point of the diagonals of the parallelogram $ABCD$,

$\therefore$ $DO=BO$, $AB\parallel DC$,

Also, since $E$ is the midpoint of $OD$,

$\therefore$ $DE=\frac{1}{2}OD=\frac{1}{4}DB$,

$\therefore$ $DE:EB=1:3$,

Also, since $AB\parallel DC$,

$\therefore$ $\triangle DEF\sim \triangle BAE$,

$\therefore$ $\frac{S_{\triangle DEF}}{S_{\triangle BEA}}=\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^2=\frac{1}{9}$,

$\therefore$ $S_{\triangle DEF}=\frac{1}{9}S_{\triangle BEA}$,

Since $\frac{S_{\triangle AOB}}{S_{\triangle BEA}}=\frac{OB}{EB}=\frac{2}{3}$,

$\therefore$ $S_{\triangle AOB}=\frac{2}{3}S_{\triangle BEA}$,

$\therefore$ $S_{\triangle DEF}:S_{\triangle OAB}=\frac{\frac{1}{9}S_{\triangle BEA}}{\frac{2}{3}S_{\triangle BEA}}=\boxed{1:6}$

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: As can be seen from the attached figure, ABCD is a parallelogram, AB is below, DC is above, and AB is parallel to DC; the diagonals AC and BD intersect at O; on the line BD there are D, E, O, B in order; the line starting from A passes through E, and continues to extend to the point F on the upper side DC. Reasoning: The diagonals of a parallelogram bisect each other, so DO=OB. Also because E is the midpoint of OD, DE=EO=OD/2. Along DB, EB=EO+OB=OD/2+OD=3OD/2, therefore DE:EB=(OD/2):(3OD/2)=1:3. Since DF is on DC, and DC∥AB, while EF and EA are on the same straight line, triangle DEF and triangle BAE are similar, with similarity ratio DE:BE=1:3, therefore the area ratio [DEF]/[BAE]=(1/3)^2=1/9. Then compare triangle AOB and triangle AEB: their bases OB and EB are both on the same straight line DB, and the height from A to DB is the same, so [AOB]/[AEB]=OB/EB=OD/(3OD/2)=2/3. Thus [DEF]/[OAB]=(1/9)/(2/3)=1/6, so the area ratio is 1:6.
